Hello! We are SKILLD by eJobs, connecting great talent with great companies.
 We are currently looking for an Senior SAP ABAP/ Fiori/ Adobe Forms Developer for a global leader in industrial connectivity solutions, based in Brașov.
 Your Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and optimize applications within the SAP environment, following the SAP Clean Core approach.
Develop modern SAP Fiori applications using SAPUI5 and OData services.
Develop and enhance CDS Views, OData services, and backend components.
Develop and enhance SAP programs and reports using ABAP and ABAP Objects.
Work with BAdIs, User Exits, and the SAP Enhancement Framework.
Develop, maintain, and optimize SAP Adobe Forms.
Perform error analysis, performance optimization, and quality assurance activities.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of SAP development processes and solutions.
 Your Profile 
University degree in (Business) Information Technology, a comparable field, or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of professional experience in SAP development.
 Strong expertise in: 
SAP ABAP and ABAP Objects
BAdIs, User Exits, and SAP Enhancement Framework
CDS Views and OData Services
SAP Fiori and SAPUI5
SAP Adobe Forms.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with SAP S/4HANA.
Knowledge of the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP).
Experience with Git, CI/CD, and modern development tools such as:
ABAP Development Tools (ADT) in Eclipse
Visual Studio Code
Experience developing SAP extensions in line with the SAP Clean Core principle.
 What We Offer 
Professional Development – Learning platforms and career development opportunities.
Structured Onboarding – Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing team support.
Private Medical Insurance – Access to quality healthcare services.
Meal Tickets – Meal tickets to support your everyday expenses.
Special Occasion Benefits – Gifts for Easter, Winter Holidays, and 8th of March.
Bonuses – Performance and employee referral bonuses.
